half_life.transformation: Use the published LARA seconds and uncertainty; retain the evaluated years separately without a new year conversion.

distribution.transformation: Retained energy, experimental density and uncertainty tokens copied unchanged. No endpoint rescaling or regeneration. Full-support piecewise-linear integration defines the conditional reference; the unit physical yield remains separate.

distribution.measurement_range: Energy range of the measurement: 11 - 18 keV      In database, transition #1

endpoint.meaning: Endpoint of the retained BetaShape transition-energy axis computed from nuclear Q and ground-state level energies; distinct from the evaluated emitted-electron Emax.

evaluated_electron_endpoint.qualification: LNHB comments derive the atomic endpoint from Q, recoil and electronic binding/final-state terms; experimental endpoints depend on chemical form. BetaShape labels this given measured Emax, for information. The LNHB tables PDF separately prints uncertainty 0.003 keV; no averaging or spectrum-axis substitution is made.

excluded_source_emissions.reason: One beta-minus branch to stable He-3 ground state. No selected prompt gamma or atomic lines; no recoil, antineutrino or placeholder incident-particle group.
